programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: We travel by train from the westernmost point of mainland Europe up to Portugal's only national park, the Peneda-Gerês, and from lively Porto to the Spanish border in the northeast. The train takes you from the blue sea to the green Douro Valley, from the urban metropolis to the scorching heat of the deserted hinterland.

programme.title: Tren Atlantico
programme.desc: Switzerland or Spain? This question is often asked by those who see pictures from northern Spain for the first time: High mountains, lonely villages, but - this is the crucial difference - also breathtaking Atlantic beaches. The "Costa Verde", the green coast, is a piece of Spain that is so different from the general tourist image of the Germans' favorite vacation destination. This area has been spared from mass tourism. We travel by train from Bilbao in the Basque Country to Santander in Cantabria and Asturias.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: The North Sea is enigmatic. It presents itself in cool shades of grey. Yet who would have guessed that beneath the chilly waves are opulent coral gardens, courting squids, and several of the largest sea creatures on the planet?

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: The paddle steamer "Skibladner" is the oldest passenger paddle steamer in the world in regular service. It has been plying Norway's largest inland lake, the Mjøsa, since 1856. The "white swan" has a melodious name, borrowed from Norse mythology. The ship "Skíðblaðnir" of the god Freyr, built by dwarves, could always have a tail wind, could be stowed in a small bag when folded and all gods in armor had room on it. The traditional ship of AS Oplandandske Dampskibsselskap does not have such fairy-tale powers, but atmospherically the "Skibladner" also transports guests to a world long gone.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Wild Holland - The Living Delta
programme.desc: The film celebrates the diverse natural heritage of the Dutch delta region while sketching the cultural context that has played such a vital part in shaping it. Using cutting edge cinematic techniques ranging from eagle’s eye aerial views to unprecedented underwater scenes, 'Wild Holland - The Living Delta' presents a portrait of this unique wetland area of Europe as never seen before, capturing it in an important moment of change - a time when new life is flooding back into the delta.

programme.title: mareTV: Hong Kong - Metropolis in the sea
programme.desc: Hong Kong translated means "fragrant harbour". The days of the spicy smoking ceremonies have passed, but MareTV has discovered many delightful contrasts between the metropolis and Mother Nature. In for-mer times, the rare eagle wood tree grew here. Its wood put the spice into the Taoist smoking ceremonies. The fragrant harbour: what sounds so charming is today a huge metropolis in the sea. No other tiny piece of land is more densely populated. Star Ferries have been commuting between the Kowloon Peninsula and central Hong Kong for the past 125 years. The British colonial masters are long gone, but on the ancient ferries, virtually nothing has changed. Most of the ships are still clad in British Racing Green and the crew still wears the old, decorative uniforms.

programme.title: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines
programme.desc: The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway (Tazara) is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects. It connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and meant independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa. The film accompanies the Tazara on its 52-hour journey through Tanzania and Zambia and uses spectacular aerial shots to show not only the architectural monuments but also the unknown sides of the previously hidden landscapes of Tanzania and Zambia.

programme.title: Germany's Wild Reservoirs
programme.desc: One of the smallest dams in the Bergisches Land is the Panzertalsperre, with an area of just four-and-a-half football pitches. On the other hand, the Dhünntalsperre is the largest with the area of 660 football pitches. They all transform a stretch of flowing water into still and stagnant water. As a result, completely diverse ecosystems have developed there: where the dipper once dived for insect larvae, cormorants and gray herons now fish and swans and coots cavort. In recent summers, even greater challenges have emerged: the effects of climate change - from extreme drought to destructive floods. On a smaller scale, a rather industrious dam master is operating flood protection: The Beaver. However, the water masses of the Wupper tore away half of his majestic timber castle - and the four young beaver kids were not seen again afterwards. Have they survived the flood? Not everyone can cope with the constant change in the dams, but they still remain an important wonder of engineering for many: for us humans as well as for a number of animals. By combining water management, ecological requirements and tourism a worthwhile goal is possible: Because for the Bergisches Land, its dams are among the most valuable and popular infrastructures that the region has to offer.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: Die letzten Schwammtaucher
programme.desc: Über Jahrhunderte war die griechische Insel Kalymnos Hochburg der Schwammtaucher. In der ganzen Welt galten sie als tollkühne Taucher mit erstaunlichem Lungenvolumen. programme.title: Tödliche Naturgewalten
programme.desc: Länder wie Saudi-Arabien sind an Hitze über 40 Grad Celsius gewöhnt. Doch als 2010 eine Hitzewelle mit ähnlichen Temperaturen über Russland hereinbrach, starben geschätzt 56.000 Menschen. Und der europäische Supersommer 2003 hinterließ rund 70.000 Todesopfer. Außergewöhnliches Bildmaterial und Klimaspezialisten gewähren einen Einblick in die genauen Zusammenhänge der beiden Hitzekatastrophen.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: Love Upstream
programme.desc: An author heads into the wilderness to write her new book. Meanwhile a romance begins to blossom between her and her guide. Starring Kimberly-Sue Murray (2021)

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: (2016) Romantic comedy starring Rachael Leigh Cook. A widowed mum enters the tech world, where love and coding crash into each other, creating the perfect romantic connection.

programme.title: Love On Retreat
programme.desc: Jenny wants to prove to her boss she would make a great wellness influencer so she will be appointed the social media manager role, but she has competition, can Jenny raise to the challenge? (2022)

programme.title: A Summer Romance
programme.desc: (2019) Pastoral romance with Erin Krakow. Determined to keep her family ranch at any cost, a woman brushes aside a charming developer who wants to buy it. Will she end up claiming his heart instead?

programme.title: Love and Sunshine
programme.desc: (2019) Feel-good romance with Danica McKellar. Retired military dog Sunshine came into Ally's life just when she needed her. But will the return of Sunshine's owner bring new heartache or new love?

programme.title: Summer of Dreams
programme.desc: (2016) Romance with Debbie Gibson. A faded pop star hits the wrong notes in life. Soon she moves home, mentors young musicians, and discovers fame is fleeting, but love lasts.

programme.title: Never Too Late To Celebrate
programme.desc: (2023) Romance with Alexa and Carlos PenaVega. Camila has no plans to celebrate her 30th. But when her Spanish tutor suggests a 'double quinceañera' to honour her Hispanic heritage, will sparks fly?

programme.title: One Perfect Match
programme.desc: (2023) Charming romcom with Merritt Patterson and Joshua Sasse. Love gets complicated for Seattle's top matchmaker when sparks fly with a mystery man, who turns out to be her new client...

programme.title: Valentine Ever After
programme.desc: Keen to escape the big city, Julia and Sydney head to Wyoming for a fun getaway. However, the trip sees Julia re-evaluate her life choices, including her career and the man she truly loves. (2016)

programme.title: Love Off the Page
programme.desc: (2022) Rom-com starring Malone Thomas. A hopeless romantic buys a book from a mysterious store, only to find its stories unfolding in real life. Will it depict her own love story?

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: Single mum Lizzy has built boundaries at work and personal life to protect herself. After meeting an impulsive pilot, Charlie, at work, will she be open to change and open herself up to love? (2019)

programme.title: Make Me A Match
programme.desc: (2023) Romance starring Rushi Kota. A dating app executive enlists the help of a matchmaker to change her fate in love. However, the matchmaker's son may be the change she needed all along.

programme.title: Matching Hearts
programme.desc: (2020) Romance starring Taylor Cole. A professional matchmaker is tasked with matchmaking a perpetually single man to boost her company's profile. Could the perfect match be right in front of them?

programme.title: And So It Goes
programme.desc: (2014) Comedy with Diane Keaton and Michael Douglas. A cranky, self-centred realtor is forced to let people in when he's left in charge of his grandchild. Doesn't everybody need good neighbours?

programme.title: Love's Match
programme.desc: (2021) Romance with Megan Hutchings. Matchmaker Leah is struggling to match one of her clients, when a fellow matchmaker offers to help. Will the pair turn out to be more than just the perfect team?

programme.title: The Soulmate Search
programme.desc: When Elen gets the chance to sign up to the notoriously exclusive dating service Eternity, she clashes with Will, her first date. They make a deal to try and get their money back.

programme.title: Gunman of Ave Maria
programme.desc: Mann is a gunman informed by a childhood friend that his father was murdered years earlier by his mother and her lover.

programme.title: Ramon the Mexican
programme.desc: Ramon avenges his brother's murder and kills the Baxter Family.

programme.title: Beyond Hatred
programme.desc: After a childhood massacre, a girl is captured by Indians and grows up among them. Years later, during renewed hostilities, she recognizes a wounded captive as her long-lost brother, forcing both sides into a brutal conflict while past and present collide on the frontier.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

programme.title: Clint the Stranger
programme.desc: Clint Harrison is a gunslinger who has been running from vengeful foes for years. He returns to the town he once abandoned and discovers his family has moved away to escape his bad reputation. Seeking redemption, he tracks them down and becomes caught in a violent conflict between farmers and a ruthless rancher willing to kill for land.

programme.title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
programme.desc: During the Civil War, Corporal MacDonald hides a large gold shipment meant for the Union. Before he can retrieve it, he's killed—taking the secret location with him. Now, a Union lieutenant and MacDonald's two sons compete to uncover the buried treasure in a tense hunt filled with danger and deception.

programme.title: Dynamite Jim
programme.desc: Union soldiers secure a shipment of gold from a sly Mexican banker, but their journey is anything but safe. Crooked outlaws, the treacherous banker himself, and the notorious Dynamite Jim all set their sights on the treasure. Betrayals and ambushes await as the race for the gold heats up.

programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
programme.desc: Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programme.title: Go with God, Gringo
programme.desc: Framed for his brother’s murder by the Cris brothers, Gringo lands in prison with a friend. When the real killers escape and abduct Carmen, he must survive daring adventures to prove his innocence and rescue her.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many
programme.desc: Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

programme.title: Where the Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

programme.title: Adiós Gringo
programme.desc: A gunslinger on the run for a murder he didn't commit goes to New Mexico where he hopes to find a person who can exculpate him. While on his way he finds a girl who has been kidnapped and tortured, sets her free and then takes his revenge at gunpoint.

programme.title: Last of the Renegades
programme.desc: As settlers encroach on Native lands, the Assiniboins go to war while Apache chief Winnetou tries to maintain peace. A corrupt oilman, Bud Forrester, orchestrates attacks to provoke conflict and seize oil-rich territory. Old Shatterhand, Winnetou, and Lord Castlepool unite to expose the scheme and prevent a full-scale war.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Vampire Genesis
programme.desc: Half-alien Teh'a flees across galaxies, hunted by a race of parasitic rulers disguised as Earth's vampires. With rebels by her side, she seeks a legendary creature: the first vampire, powerful enough to end their reign of terror.

programme.title: Twerk: Reggae Nights
programme.desc: Hard-working, single mother, Iesha, learns that one of the most popular reggae artists, Domino, is holding an audition in her city for dancers in his next music video. The competition is fierce, and some of the ladies will do anything to get the job.

programme.title: Sugar Daddy Killer
programme.desc: Sasha has just ended a relationship with her boyfriend and is looking for a fresh start. Her friend Tonya tells her she needs to get a Sugar Daddy to forget about her boyfriend, and get her bills paid. Sasha starts dating a Sugar Daddy and decides she is going to scam him. When Sasha’s Sugar Daddy wants more than conversation, she is forced to kill him. Now Sasha decides to start killing one Sugar Daddy after the next to get all the money she can.

programme.title: Blood or Not
programme.desc: Two brothers, one of the law, the other of the streets, find themselves making the choice of "Blood" or "Not".

programme.title: Code of Envy
programme.desc: Mariah is living a truly fulfilling life with her husband and two best friends. One night, she runs into her old friend Neveah. After taking pity on her and her current circumstance, Neveah leeches onto Mariah and her life, sparking Nevaeh's jealousy and transforming her into the dangerous alter ego, Envy, endangering their friendship and lives.

programme.title: Gutter
programme.desc: Raised in poverty, Gutter realizes thriving in this world, means embracing the streets that made him.

programme.title: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Jessica is the smartest girl on campus tutoring the most popular football player, Ryan. He is loved by many but he also has a few enemies. After the football team wins the championship game, Ryan decides to throw an after party at his house. When campus police find Ryan’s dead body, multiple people have a motive to want him dead. Will Jessica and her friend uncover the truth before it’s too late?

programme.title: Sinful Paradise: Welcome to Paradise
programme.desc: Follows the women and operators of Paradise, one of the hottest gentleman’s club in Atlanta, with high profile clients and beautiful women, and one of the only female owned clubs in the city. The owner, Cat, and her business partner SP protect their dynasty, and follows the stories and obstacles of its dancers.

programme.title: A Wonderful Lie
programme.desc: Fading romance author Rebecca Sinclair concocts a desperate plan to reignite her dwindling career and fractured marriage. She creates a web of lies and her twisted plot leaves her trapped in a nightmare of her own making. Rebecca must scramble to keep control or risk being consumed by the very deception of her own doing.

programme.title: His Target
programme.desc: Keya meets Justin, an aspiring entrepreneur and thought she found the man of her dreams, but he saw her as an opportunity to make his ventures soar. The closer she gets to him, the more she falls in love, but his grip grows tighter and deadlier. A toxic relationship, soon grows into a power struggle with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she’s always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she’s truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: Syndicate Sadists
programme.desc: After his friend is murdered, a biker ignites a war between two mob families.

programme.title: Audition
programme.desc: While searching for a prospective wife, a deceptive widower (Ryo Ishibashi) meets a mysterious and deadly woman (Eihi Shiina).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: So sieht Weitsprung bei den Stunt Heroes der action concept aus: ein Fahrzeug soll mit hoher Geschwindigkeit über vier nacheinander explodierende Fahrzeuge springen. Eine Frage von Präzision und Timing. Nachwuchsstuntfrau Tina soll beweisen, dass sie es kann. Spektakulärer, actionreicher Stunttest mit Garantie auf blaue Flecken!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes drehen einen Autoüberschlag, aber das ist Stuntkoordinator Carl nicht genug. Deshalb legt er gleich noch eine saftige Schießerei mit drauf. Außerdem hat er für seinen Werkstattchef eine Überraschung parat: Uwe soll beim Überschlag auf dem Beifahrersitz Platz nehmen-zum allerersten Mal!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes zeigen was passieren kann, wenn ein Mensch in ein Auto fliegt: es explodiert und bricht völlig in sich zusammen! Welche Tricks und Vorbereitung dafür nötig sind, wie ein Auto weich gemacht wird und wie man richtig vom Hochhaus springt, verraten die Stunt Heroes in dieser Folge der Action-Reportage.

programme.title: Harley Davidson Trio
programme.desc: Drei brandneue Harleys kommen mit dem aktuellen Jahrgang frisch in die Showrooms. Dyna Switchback, Sportster 72 und Softail Slim heißen die Neulinge in diesem Jahr. Sie sprechen völlig unterschiedliche Zielgruppen an - aber jede schafft das auf ihre Art so konsequent, wie man das von den Charakter-Bikes aus Milwaukee schon ewig gewohnt ist.

programme.title: Allradantrieb - Wer hat's erfunden?
programme.desc: Audi? Jeep? Subaru? Oder doch jemand ganz anderes? Wer hat den Allradantrieb erfunden? Um das heraus zu finden, müssen wir über 100 Jahre in die Vergangenheit reisen. Wie sicher der Vierradantrieb unsere Autos macht, testen wir anhand des Volvo V60: Front gegen Allrad - auf einer schneebedeckten Teststrecke in Österreich.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: Nick Uhas und seine Gäste gehen der Frage auf den Grund, ob Gedankenkontrolle möglich ist, warum Objekte und Menschen dazu neigen, sich zu synchronisieren, und welche magischen Geheimnisse Magnesium verbirgt.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt
programme.desc: In erfrischenden Experimenten wird gezeigt, wie Wasser ein Feuer entfacht, Frühstücksflocken in einen Magnetfelddetektor verwandelt und sogar die Art und Weise verändern kann, wie wir die Welt um uns herum wahrnehmen.

programme.title: Wissenschaft mit Wow-Effekt

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Alles beginnt mit ein paar Strichen im Sand. 1948 experimentieren die Studenten Bernard Silver und Norman Joseph Woodland mit frühen Formen der Strichcode-Technologie. Der von ihnen erfundene Strichcode revolutioniert den Welthandel.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In den 1920er Jahren verwandeln Investoren Florida von einer sumpfigen Provinzgegend in ein nobles Urlaubsparadies. Immobilienspekulationen und das Erschließen von immer mehr Land führen zu Floridas erster Immobilienblase, die 1926 platzt.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Mauvein, der erste synthetischen Farbstoff der Welt, fasziniert die Menschen auf der ganzen Welt, hält in der Modeindustrie Einzug, lässt Lebensmittel appetitlicher aussehen und erlaubt erstaunliche Fortschritte in der Medizin.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: 1841 gelingt dem 12-jährigen Sklave Edmond Albius die erste manuelle Bestäubung der wertvollen Gewürzvanille. Danach tritt die Vanille auf der ganzen Welt ihren Siegeszug an und löst in Sachen künstliche Aromen eine Revolution aus.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Der Hollywood-Star Hedy Lamarr entwickelt während des Zweiten Weltkriegs das Frequenzsprungverfahren, ein sicheres Kommunikationssystem für Torpedos. Heute dient Lamarrs Erfindung als Grundlage für Mobilfunk-Technologien wie WiFi oder GPS.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In den frühen Tagen des Internets werden Videonutzer von niedriger Auflösung und langen Pufferzeiten geplagt. Doch das „Content Delivery Network“ oder CDN revolutioniert das Streamen von Videos und legt den Grundstein für das Netflix-Zeitalter.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: Mit dem „Federal Aid Highway Act” von 1956 ruft der amerikanische Präsident Dwight D. Eisenhower ein gewaltiges Infrastrukturprojekt ins Leben. Jeder Winkel Amerikas soll mit Autobahnen erschlossen werden, um die Nachkriegswirtschaft anzukurbeln.

programme.title: Das Aha-Erlebnis
programme.desc: In Menlo Park, dem vermutlich ersten Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum der Welt, wird der Akt des Erfindens neu gedacht. Was seit Jahrhunderten als eine Solo-Aktivität gilt, wird nun zu Teamarbeit.

programme.desc: "Vorsprung durch Technik" (Vantagem através da tecnologia) em pistas de rali. O Audi Quattro choca seus oponentes.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: Winterkrieg
programme.desc: November 1939. Stalin befiehlt den Angriff auf Finnland, an der Grenze marschieren 500.000 sowjetische Soldaten auf. Für das kleine Finnland beginnt der Kampf gegen einen übermächtigen Feind. Die Brüder Martti (Taneli Mäkelä) und Paavo Hakala (Konsta Mäkelä) aus Österbotten schließen sich dem Infanterieregiment 'JR23' an, welches nach Karelien abkommandiert wird. Bei minus 40 Grad erleben sie die Hölle des Winterkriegs in der verlustreichen Schlacht von Taipale. Den russischen Panzern und Flugzeugen können die Finnen nur ihre einfachen Waffen und selbstgebastelten Molotow-Cocktails entgegen halten. Viele von Marttis Kameraden finden einen eisigen Tod, die verbleibenden Männer werden an die Mannerheim-Linie verlegt. Diese gilt es um jeden Preis zu halten, denn wenn die Mannerheim-Linie fällt, fällt ganz Finnland...

programme.title: Djangos blutige Spur
programme.desc: Deborah Cater wartet auf ihren Bruder Jeff, einen ehemaligen Offizier, der aus der Kriegsgefangenschaft heimkehrt. Sie hat ihre Farm teuer an eine Transportgesellschaft verkauft, die dort eine Eisenbahnstrecke verlegen will. Ihr indianischer Angestellter Jerome beobachtet sie, als sie das Geld in Empfang nimmt, und verrät dies dem Outlaw Carlos Martinez. Dieser beschließt, das Geld zu stehlen.

programme.title: Abrechnung in San Franzisko
programme.desc: Ein Mafiaboss ist wütend, als er verdächtigt wird, eine Heroinlieferung nach San Francisco geschmuggelt zu haben. Er entsendet seinen Neffen, einen hochkarätigen anglo-sizilianischen Anwalt, um den wahren Schuldigen zu identifizieren. Der Anwalt holt sich auch die Hilfe seines besten Freundes, eines abenteuerlustigen Grand-Prix-Fahrers.

programme.title: Amanda Knox - Der Engel mit den Eisaugen
programme.desc: Im Herbst 2007 wird die britische Austauschstudentin Meredith Kercher brutal ermordet in ihrer Wohnung im italienischen Perugia aufgefunden. Schnell geraten ihre Mitbewohnerin, die amerikanische Studentin Amanda Knox, und deren italienischer Freund Raffaele Sollecito ins Visier der Ermittlungen. Der Film folgt den dramatischen Wendungen des Falls: von der ersten Verhaftung über die mediale Hetzjagd bis hin zum aufsehenerregenden Gerichtsprozess. Während Amanda von der Presse als „Foxy Knoxy“ dämonisiert wird, stellt sich die Frage: Ist sie eine kaltblütige Mörderin oder selbst ein Opfer von Vorurteilen, Justizirrtümern und öffentlicher Vorverurteilung? Das Doku-Drama beleuchtet die emotionalen und juristischen Abgründe eines der umstrittensten Mordprozesse der 2000er-Jahre und wirft einen kritischen Blick auf Medienmacht, Polizeiarbeit und die Suche nach Wahrheit in einem Fall, der die Welt bewegte.

programme.title: The Operation – Im Sumpf der Korruption
programme.desc: In den frühen Morgenstunden wartet eine Einheit der brasilianischen Bundespolizei auf ihren großen Einsatz: Ein LKW, beladen mit knapp 700 Kilogramm reinstem Kokain. Was die Polizisten jedoch nicht ahnen: Sie stecken nun mitten drin, im größten Korruptionsskandal der Geschichte. Im Mittelpunkt steht dabei ein weltweit operierendes Bauunternehmen mit diffusen Geldwäschemethoden bis hinauf in die höchsten Regierungskreise. Eine nervenaufreibende Jagd nach den Drahtziehern, Nutznießern und der Wahrheit beginnt, welche die Justiz noch Jahre lang beschäftigen soll...

programme.title: Cobbler - Der Schuhmagier
programme.desc: Als Max Simkin (Adam Sandler) eines Tages entdeckt, dass die alte Leder-Nähmaschine in seinem Keller magische Kräfte besitzt, öffnet sich das Tor in eine neue Welt für den Schuhmacher. Er kann von nun an in die Identität jedes Kunden schlüpfen, dessen Schuhe er mit der alten Maschine repariert hat. Was für ein Abenteuer! Der stille, zurückgezogene Mann zieht erstmal los und probiert sich aus. Doch bald dämmert ihm, dass die neue magische Freiheit nicht ganz ungefährlich ist und auch ein gutes Stück Verantwortung bedeutet. Ist doch einer seiner Kunden Gangster Leon Ludlow (Method Man), dessen Schuhe Max wie angegossen passen.

programme.title: Die Legende der weißen Schlange
programme.desc: Als Kräutersammler Xu Xian (Raymond Lam) in Lebensgefahr gerät, eilt ihm eine geheimnisvolle Schöne (Eva Huang) zur Hilfe. Diese entpuppt sich jedoch als keine gewöhnliche Frau, sondern als ein Schlangendämon, welcher in Gestalt einer Frau auftritt – White Snake. Die Beiden verlieben sich Hals über Kopf ineinander. Doch ihr Glück währt nur kurz, denn eine mysteriöse Seuche bricht über das Land herein und stürzt es in ein Chaos. White Snake hilft erneut, indem sie ihre Kräfte einsetzt, um ein Heilmittel für die leidende Bevölkerung zu kreieren. Das ruft den mächtigen Zauberer Fa Hai (Jet Li) auf den Plan. Er hält die Magie White Snakes für böse und will die Dämonenfrau vernichten. Es kommt zum Showdown, zum Kampf auf Leben und Tod...

programme.title: Mr. Collins' zweiter Frühling
programme.desc: In den 70er Jahren war Rockmusiker Danny Collins (Al Pacino) ein Megastar und Hit-Garant. Jetzt, über vierzig Jahre später, wird er von einer verpassten Chance wieder eingeholt. Denn nachdem er von seinem Manager Frank Grubman (Christopher Plummer) einen Brief erhält, den John Lennon ihm 1971 persönlich geschrieben hat, beginnt er seinen bisherigen Rock'n'Roll-Lifestyle zu überdenken. Dabei knüpft er nicht nur erstmals Kontakte zu seinem entfremdeten Sohn Tom Donnelly (Bobby Cannavale) und dessen Frau Samantha (Jennifer Garner), sondern auch zu der charmanten Hotelmanagerin Mary Sinclair (Annette Bening), die eigentlich so gar nicht dem Beuteschema des alternden Stars entspricht und ihm entsprechend skeptisch gegenübertritt...

programme.title: Sympathy for Delicious
programme.desc: Seinem Job als DJ kann Dean O'Dwyer nach einem Unfall nicht mehr nachgehen. Doch das Schicksal meint es gut mit ihm: In der Band von Ariel bekommt er eine neue Chance. Doch während er sich mit Leadsänger The Stain und Managerin Nina anlegt, entdeckt er eine unglaubliche Gabe: Er kann durch Handauflegen Menschen heilen. Doch welchen Weg wird er einschlagen? Den des Rockstars oder des Retters?

programme.title: The Wedding Party: Was ist schon Liebe?
programme.desc: Steve steht kurz vor einem Bankrott und Ana ist auf der Suche nach einem Australier, der bereit ist sie im Gegenzug für eine Aufenthaltsgenehmigung zu heiraten. Die beiden vereinbaren einen Deal, in dem Ana Steve eine ordentliche Summe zahlt und sie sich im Gegenzug vermählen. Steve hat vor niemandem davon zu erzählen und nach der Hochzeit sein Leben wie gewohnt weiter zu leben. Ein neugieriger Freund der Familie bekommt jedoch Wind von dem Plan und von der vorstehenden Hochzeit. Kurzerhand wird eine große Feier geplant. Doch Steve erwartet ein Dilemma, denn eigentlich möchte er keine Lüge leben und empfindet zudem etwas für eine andere Frau namens Jacqui.

programme.title: Driveways
programme.desc: Die alleinerziehende Kathy reist mit ihrem achtjährigen Sohn Cody in eine Kleinstadt, um das Haus ihrer verstorbenen Schwester April zu übernehmen und den Nachlass zu regeln. Doch das heruntergekommene Gebäude stellt sie vor unerwartete Herausforderungen: kein Strom, kein Internet und ein Berg von Gerümpel, der entrümpelt werden muss. Während Kathy sich zunehmend fragt, wie wenig sie ihre Schwester eigentlich kannte, versucht der schüchterne Cody, sich in der fremden Umgebung zurechtzufinden. Dabei begegnet er dem zurückgezogen lebenden Nachbarn Del, einem 83-jährigen Kriegsveteranen und Witwer. Aus der anfänglichen Zurückhaltung entwickelt sich eine stille, berührende Freundschaft zwischen dem Jungen und dem alten Mann. Der Sommer wird für alle Beteiligten zu einer Zeit der Reflexion, des Wandels und der leisen Hoffnung.

programme.title: Leben oder so ähnlich
programme.desc: Das Leben der ehrgeizigen und egozentrischen TV-Moderatorin Lanie Kerrigan (Angelina Jolie) verläuft perfekt. Sie steht vor einer Beförderung, ist mit einem Baseball-Star verlobt und hat eine top gestylte Wohnung. Während einer Reportage trifft sie den Propheten Jack (Tony Shalhoub), der verkündet, dass sie in einer Woche sterben wird. Diese Prophezeiung stellt Lanies geordnete Welt völlig auf den Kopf. Plötzlich sieht sie nicht nur ihren Kameramann und Intimfeind Pete (Edward Burns) mit ganz anderen Augen...

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: María Lucía sigue sin volver con su familia. Y, estando con Leo en una casa de campo, comienzan a pasar cosas entre ellos. A Trinidad le aterra esa relación, porque sospecha que María Lucía podría ser la hija de Miguel Ferrándiz. Virginia comienza a trabajar en la empresa. Pero las cosas se complican cuando se filtra en un correo electrónico el rumor de que Virginia mató a Miguel. Leonardo y Carlos Ernesto tratan de buscar al responsable. El capítulo finaliza cuando Trinidad, preocupada por la posibilidad de que su nieta sea pariente de Leo Ferrándiz, se acerca a la casa de Jimena para que puedan hablar del éste tema que les incumbe a ambas.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad le cuenta a Jimena que Miguel es el padre de María Lucía. Jimena, a su vez, va a hablar con Carlos, que le revela un secreto sobre Miguel que empeora aún más la situación. Irene cree que está embarazada y va a la casa de Zulay a hacerse un test. Agustina amenaza con echar a todo el personal de la casa si nadie admite haber destruido el cuadro de su hermana. Leonardo descubre quién envió el mail sobre Virginia. Rodrigo manda a Alejandra a Madrid para que tenga una reunión muy importante con Adolfo. Allí, Alejandra descubre un gran secreto y se ve involucrada en un extraño plan.

programme.title: Episodio 9

Aterrado por el impacto, Ricardo decide ocultar la devastadora verdad, tejiendo una nueva red de mentiras. Celia y su aliada llegan a la clínica; su odio es tan ciego que desea la muerte de Manuela. Mientras Marcelo confronta a Celia, Moisés sospecha que su familia está detrás de su misterioso secuestro. En las sombras, Gustavo vaga como indigente presintiendo que algo grave le pasa a su hermana.

Una vez en la comisaría, el comisario Zulbaga le explica que las pruebas para su detención fueron que alguien declaró ser cómplice de él al haber puesto el arma en su auto. Ese alguien fue Domingo, quien contratado por Reina, colocó el arma en el coche de Eloy, y al encontrar sus huellas digitales, la policía también lo detuvo. Sol logra contactarse con un hombre que trabajó en un quiosco frente a donde Reina abandonó a su bebé.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Se encuentran en la junta directiva | todos se sorprenden cuando Briggite entró con Yubiri | porque las juntas directivas no son para las asistentes | pero | Briggite les dijo que las ideas que traían eran de Yubiri. Mientras tanto | Segundo y Carolina se comen unas hamburguesas y hablan sobre el despecho de ella. Al finalizar la junta directiva | Atanasio le dice a Briggite que no le gustó nada que ella hubiera llevado a Yubiri a la reunión y que más bien debería haberla botado de la agencia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer

Ricardo defiende a Manuela de Misael, mientras Margot cuida la salud de su hija. Amparo se reúne con Celia por su nieto en un clima de tensiones familiares y verdades ocultas.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro lleva a Rosa a su casa contra el rechazo de Amalia, quien no la acepta. Junior, despechado, discute con Alejandro y lo amenaza con revelar la verdad sobre Rosa. Erasto presiona a Arminda y Eustoquio exigiendo saber si ya es viudo. Arminda visita a Carmen y miente sobre el parentesco entre Erasto y Rosa. José Luis, celoso de que Natalia esté con Erasto, le oculta la información del asesinato. Alejandro, intrigado, interroga a Rosa sobre el joven muerto sospechando que era su hermano, mientras la familia Alamo se desmorona internamente.

programme.title: Amor Secreto

Irene cree que está embarazada y va a la casa de Zulay a hacerse un test. Agustina amenaza con echar a todo el personal de la casa si nadie admite haber destruido el cuadro de su hermana. Leonardo descubre quién envió el mail sobre Virginia. Rodrigo manda a Alejandra a Madrid para que tenga una reunión muy importante con Adolfo. Allí, Alejandra descubre un gran secreto y se ve involucrada en un extraño plan.

Leonardo y Jimena discuten por un correo electrónico que ella hizo circular por la empresa revelando el pasado de Virginia. programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Qué bonito amor. Emiliano y Rosario disfrutan de su segunda noche juntos. Mientras tanto, Raquel espera impaciente a Rosario en casa. Por otro lado, Leticia es atracada en la calle y debe recurrir a Fernando para que la ayude.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Todo está listo para el encuentro entre Emiliano y Martin. Emiliano quedará derrumbado y perderá el control al conocer toda la verdad a boca de su cuñado. Emiliano le dará indicaciones a Martin para poder arreglar la situación en la que está.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Moisés y Leandro sufren por la viruela. Matilde se dedica a cuidar de su marido. Nacha decide cuidar de su hijo Leandro, quien al mejorar le agradece componiéndole La viruela. Arturo intenta persuadir a Gerardo de desistir del robo de ganado.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Ante la llegada de Olimpo, Arturo decide dejarle el camino libre a Gala. Moisés le miente a Matilde sobre Plácida. Erótida y Mauricio hablan de lo que pudo haber sido su vida. A pesar de su disfonía, Leandro sigue con sus planes de grabar el disco.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Gracias a Reinaldo, Leandro recupera su voz. Arturo queda en evidencia frente a los Pantoja. Don Julio, con rabia por el asunto del robo de ganado, amenaza a Arturo y a su familia. Onofre, Nacha, Tomasa y Urbano vuelven a Los Pajales.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: Arturo va a Barranquilla y conoce a Miriam, quien roba sus pertenencias. Al llegar a Barranquilla, Arturo consigue que un empresario musical lo contrate. Leandro logra recuperar la confianza de los tocaimeros y termina la canción dedicada a ellos.

programme.title: Leandro
programme.desc: En la cárcel, Leandro se desahoga con su compañero de celda. Miriam se acerca a Matilde con dudosas intenciones. Chico saca a Leandro de la cárcel y se encuentran con Matilde. Moisés se entera de que Matilde está con Leandro y la sigue.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Macías insiste en que Rosario debe salir del Bar Plaza Garibaldi y por esta razón solicitará una entrevista de trabajo para ella en su empresa. Por otro lado, El capitán Bernal informa al comandante Salas que ya tienen ubicado a Emiliano en Colombia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis van con Emiliano a dar una serenata de despecho y este se emborracha al saber que Rosario esta con Javier. Emiliano llegara amanecido a casa de Rosario para reclamarle, pero termina declarándole todo su amor.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas llega a entrevistarse con Sanchez y se da cuenta que tienen ala persona equivocada. Por otro lado, Fernando descubre la verdadera identidad de Emiliano y enfurecido le pide que se desaparezca de la vida de Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando decide escuchar a Emiliano antes de condenarlo, Emiliano le cuenta a Fernando todo lo que paso en México y el porqué de su huida. Por otro lado, Martin y Steve declaran en el juicio en contra de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El capitán Gregorio Bernal decide llevar al comandante Leonardo Salas al Bar Plaza Garibaldi en contra de su voluntad. Emiliano saldrá a la tarima sin saber que el capitán Bernal y el comandante Salas están en el bar.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano llega donde Virginia a revisar el carro y se da cuenta del sabotaje que prepararon. Emiliano esta por meterse en graves problemas por la obsesión que tiene Virginia de estar con él. Mientras tanto, Rosario sufre por los celos.

programme.title: Diomedes

Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). Connor isn’t used to having a woman in the house again, but Amber’s sincerity and kindness help bridge their awkwardness and bring the family together.

programme.title: Heaven Is Waiting
programme.desc: It has been years since Ned Stevens, a charming self-made success, lost his wife Kate to cancer. Yet he still can't let go of her memory and move forward with his life.. But when Liz brings home a new boyfriend from college -- Ned finds that his comfortable world is turned upside down as Liz tries to divert his attention to Carol, an attractive single woman who lives in Ned's neighborhood.

programme.title: Our Wild Hearts
programme.desc: Willow (Cambrie Schroder), a determined young teenager, is obsessed with the idea of meeting the father she never knew. She leaves her cushy life in Malibu to travel to the Sierra Nevada mountains, where she pays a surprise visit to Jack (Ricky Schroder), a rugged cowboy who has no idea he’s a father. As the two struggle to bond, Willow makes a connection with a wild mustang, Bravo. Jack wants to capture and tame the magnificent horse, but Willow is convinced he needs to be free. Will the wild stallion that brought them together end up tearing them apart?

programme.desc: When you start with a frame from a C-10 truck there is only one way for this project to go….down. We’ll give the C-10 frame a 2-inch drop and bolt on a ton of cool new parts.

programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The time has finally come. Brett Torino is coming and he is here for his car, the legendary 1 of 2 ever made, 1970 Coronet! Mark wouldn’t be Mark, though, without a few tricks up his sleeve. When Brett arrives to collect on his long restoration from the Mopar Master, the reveal of this truly one of a kind car is done with style. But not before Mark takes us back through the entire restoration leading up to that point. It Is the last 1970 Hemi Coronet Convertible on earth, after all.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Daren is given control of the shop for a week. Darenʼs constant pestering and ribbing leads Mark to hand him the reigns of Graveyard Carz for a week. But instead of getting things done, Daren starts inventing new field trips and distractions for the crew, as well as becoming obsessed with getting his personal Dodge Challenger running again.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark receives an angry call from the owner of the 1970 Roadrunner, which leads to a mad rush to get the car finished in time. Meanwhile, Josh pushes the crew into committing to some New Years resolutions.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Frustrated by the crew's complaints that he spends all day being lazy in the front office. Mark is determined to prove to the guys that there is more to restoring a car than physical labor. Josh and Daren visit the crash site of the mangled orange 1971 'Cuda.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: As the team works to complete a multitude of cars, Mark stresses over the metal dipping of the very rare and valuable ʻ71 Cuda 440-6. Tensions are high and time is limited, is the GYC crew up to the pressure?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the remains back from the '71 440 Six Barrel, 4 Speed, Shaker Hood Phantom Cuda and determine if the car can be resurrected. A '69 Dodge Daytona Charger arrives ready to be brought back from the dead and Mark gets a 2011 SRT8 Dodge Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the N96 Air Grabber installed on the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car. It's started and is ready for final assembly. The owners of '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car visit to check on the restoration progress.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark is hired to restore the body, paint, and suspension of a '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The shop gets some needed upgrades and the '71 Charger 440 Six Pack Triple Green car is completed to OEM Specifications.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The '70 Sunroof Challenger is painted and ready for final assembly. The '69 Daytona Charger is disassembled and readied to be shipped to the media blasters. Mark and the Ghoulz head out to the junkyard to blow off some steam playing paintball.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz use their brand new Shop Crane to lower the body of the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car onto its restored suspension and its drive-train is assembled and installed.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The '69 Daytona Charger returns from the media blaster and Mark gives Josh a history lesson on the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel Car before removing it's drive-train and suspension.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The ghouls get the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car completely disassembled and off to the media blaster. Mark disassembles and restores the right-hand door to the 71' 440 Phantom Cuda. In addition, the headliner and vinyl top is installed in the 71 'Phantasm' Tribute car.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 6, World Strongest Team 1
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 7, World Strongest Team 2
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.
